items.title: Dorothy Donegan — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He used to play, you could hear him in the alley. “Fatha’ Hines, Fatha’ Hines.” So I would try to mimic him.

ctx.x: Tell me about this broadcast from the Grand Terrace.
He used to play, you could hear him in the alley. “Fatha’ Hines, Fatha’ Hines.” So I would try to mimic him.
And how old were you at the time?
